notes.title: The last devlog and more news about the release postponement
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/ff2d45f1ee77a2a739b1543d7f99e8c8728ae1bc.jpg
Hello dear friends, we are almost there - and we want to share some important news:

✅ The game has passed Steam moderation! 🎉 And not only that: we've had time to test it through Steam, added achievements and put the finishing touches. Everything is ready for launch!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3511020/YA_pyu_SHHavelevyj_Kofe_chtoby_perezapustit_realnost_no_na_menya_oxotyatsya_MonstroDevushki_i_vooruzhennye_agenty/

📆 The release has been postponed to June 6th... but this is definitely the date - the last deadline! After a few minor delays related to the final stages of publishing, we have decided on the final date. On June 6th, Sorrel Coffee will be available on Steam. No postponements. No waiting. Just you, your choices and a cup of coffee that will change reality.

🎯 Mini-devlog from the development team: 
✅ Passed Steam moderation 
✅ Tested the game with Steam 
✅ Added in-game achievements 
✅ As before, all DLC (artbook, wallpapers, 18+ content) are fully ready 
✅ Localizations, text, voice-over in Russian - all collected in one seamless experience

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/be7f0444fd044f4cae1d7e10e66b2b778df8a941.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/c3deb12c7645652d184ceb09b9fbb950e99de18d.png

💚 Thank you for your patience and interest in our project. You helped us grow, develop the game and believe in it even in the most difficult moments. Now there's just a little bit left - and you will be able to make your choice, meet mysterious girls and find out what's behind a cup of Sorrel Coffee.

⏳ See you on June 6th 💗 Add the game to your wishlist so you don't miss the release:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3511020/YA_pyu_SHHavelevyj_Kofe_chtoby_perezapustit_realnost_no_na_menya_oxotyatsya_MonstroDevushki_i_vooruzhennye_agenty/

notes.title: Sorrel Coffee’s release delay
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/1d5d0894967a8333f536c28423471f1089f4ac2c.jpg
📅✨ An update from the Sorrel Coffee team ✨

Friends, we are very close to release - the game is fully ready, everything is assembled, tested and waiting for you! 🎮💖

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3511020/YA_pyu_SHHavelevyj_Kofe_chtoby_perezapustit_realnost_no_na_menya_oxotyatsya_MonstroDevushki_i_vooruzhennye_agenty/

However, we have a small change in plans:

🚫 The release is postponed from May 23rd to May 30th

The reason is simple: we haven't passed the final Steam moderation yet. Everything else - artwork, code, localizations, 18+ DLC and bonus content - is already in the game and ready to go. There's only one hurdle left, and we're sure we'll overcome it very soon!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500726/cc0b98b8fc4ba81860be0094f530707bb0514720.jpg

🙏 We are very sorry for the delay and appreciate your understanding and patience. You can rest assured that you'll be able to order your cup of Sorrel Coffee and dive into our story very soon. 

Thank you for your support, interest in the project and patience. We will make this coffee worthy of your attention 💗

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3511020/YA_pyu_SHHavelevyj_Kofe_chtoby_perezapustit_realnost_no_na_menya_oxotyatsya_MonstroDevushki_i_vooruzhennye_agenty/
